---
name: Measurement concern
about: The instrument gave a result you believe is wrong
labels: measurement
---

**Which instrument**
<!-- clarity-index / reader-test / cloze-test -->

**What it reported**
<!-- The score or finding -->

**Why you believe that is wrong**
<!-- What you know about the document or the readers that the result contradicts -->

**Was the answer key taken from the source document, or from the document under test?**
<!-- A key skimmed off the artifact under test cannot fail, and is the most common cause of a
     falsely passing reader test. -->

**If reader-test: was the reader genuinely fresh?**
<!-- A subagent inherits the project's CLAUDE.md and memory files. If those describe the
     subject, the reader answers from them rather than from the document. -->

**If cloze-test: who took it?**
<!-- It must be real people. A model restores missing words from context far better than a
     person, so a model's score proves nothing about human readers. -->

**Document and audience**
<!-- Type, length, and who it was written for -->
